# librechat_group (Resource)

A local LibreChat group. Groups are what make sharing worth doing: an agent or MCP server granted to a group is usable by its members without anyone being named individually, and membership changes without touching the grant.

Only `source = "local"` groups are managed here. A group synced from Entra ID is owned by that sync and must not be adopted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# member_ids are ObjectId *strings*, which is what LibreChat's schema declares and how it
# resolves membership. Referencing librechat_user.x.id produces the right form.
resource "librechat_group" "support" {
  name        = "Support"
  description = "Everyone who answers tickets."

  member_ids = [librechat_user.agent.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, shown in the sharing dialog.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text describing who the group is for.
- `email` (String) Optional address associated with the group; LibreChat indexes but does not send to it.
- `member_ids` (Set of String) Member accounts, as ObjectId strings - `librechat_user.x.id`.

These are stored as **strings**, not as ObjectIds, because that is what LibreChat's schema declares (`memberIds: [String]`) and how it resolves membership: `Group.find({ memberIds: user.idOnTheSource || String(user._id) })`. An ObjectId written here matches nothing - the user resolves to zero groups, every grant made to the group quietly stops applying, and nothing errors. The provider always writes the string form, so referencing `librechat_user.x.id` is correct.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) ObjectId of the group. This is what a `librechat_grant` with `principal_type = "group"` expects.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By group name, or by the document's ObjectId.
terraform import librechat_group.support Support
```
